=== Day 3: the town meeting ===
Agnes: "Oh, last night, communing with the dead at Greta's hearth, I learned nothing they hadn't already told us."
Agnes: "I did see Constance out on the Docks last night."  [case board: #94, #95]
Constance: "I must voice my misgivings regarding Merrin; their conduct troubles me."  [case board: #57]
Merrin: "Beware Constance, good neighbors, before it's too late! My reading, taken with the other reports, leaves them among the likeliest."  [case board: #96]
Bartholomew: "I'm with Merrin. Something off with Constance."  [case board: #97]
Odette: "Are we doing public confessions tonight? Let's get mine over with: I am the Night Watch."
Odette: "The night before you arrived, I watched the Docks: nobody stirred."
Odette: "On the first night, I watched the Market: I saw Nisha out."
Odette: "Last night, I watched the Docks: I saw Merrin out."
Odette: "Miraculously, Constance and I are of one mind regarding Merrin. I saw them out on the Docks last night, while I was out on my duty."  [case board: #98, #99, #100, #101, #102]
Nisha: "It isn't a locked deduction yet, still—my read on Agnes isn't clean."
Nisha: "I did see Odette out on the Market on the first night."  [case board: #103, #104]
Agnes: "I'm with Merrin when it comes to Constance, neighbors."  [case board: #105]
